mapper.select: SELECT T.notice_id, T.title, T.category_cd, U.user_name, T.create_dt, T.view_account, T.del_yn FROM t3000_notice T JOIN T1000_account A ON COALESCE(T.update_Id, T.create_id) = A.account_id JOIN t1000_user U ON A.user_no = U.user_no WHERE T.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY T.notice_id DESC

SELECT T.notice_id, T.title,T.content, T.update_dt, T.create_dt, T.CREATE_ID , T.update_id, T.del_yn, T.view_account, U.user_name FROM t3000_notice T JOIN t1000_account A ON COALESCE(T.update_id, T.create_id) = A.account_id JOIN t1000_user U ON A.user_no = U.user_no WHERE T.notice_id = #{noticeId}
